# Scopus

## Basic Information
- Type: other
- Source: [_id-286_current_version](../sources/_id-286_current_version.qmd)

## Description
Scopus is a comprehensive abstract and citation database of peer-reviewed literature. It is frequently utilized alongside [Web of Science](web-of-science.qmd) to capture a broader thematic spread, particularly reflecting applied industrial knowledge cycles through conference papers. The database serves as a foundational tool for bibliometric analysis and research mapping, providing deep insight into scientific and technical trends.
